profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Check out my Portfolio: www.valeryn.com

I enjoy collaborating with other engineers and developers and tackling challenging problems together. 
What I like most is solving complex problems all over the stack. I specialize in C++, Go, JavaScript, ReactJS, ReduxJS, Angular, Ruby, Rails, Java, GraphQL, Docker, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and more.

After graduating from UCLA with a Bachelor of Science degree, I started my career with ORANO. There, I worked 2 years on automation hardware and 5+ years on the control systems software.

Moving back to the Bay Area, I decided to focus on Web Development and stepped in the Tech industry with AlertEnterprise. After 1.5 year, I joined Google, where I am at presently.

Outside of Software Development, I am also passionate about emerging tech (e.g blockchain, AI) and their impact on international economics + social policies. As I lived in France for 17 years, I like exploring what makes each culture unique and exciting!

portfolio: valeryn.com
github: github.com/valery-nguyen

TECHNICAL SKILLS / SPECIALTIES
• Languages: C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, GraphQL
• Frameworks: React.js, Redux.js, Angular, Express.js, Node.js, Rails
• Database: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server
• Platforms: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Heroku, GCP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Maintaining and improving the experimentation infrastructure, which provides the means to run A/B tests and launches for all Google products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated on a team of 6 to architect the infrastructure solutions for new cloud-based product services running on Google Cloud Platform.
• Containerized microservices using Docker and built Kubernetes and Helm manifests used for deployments to Google Kubernetes Engine.
• Supported the internal engineering and sales teams by migrating 7+ on-premise applications to the cloud.
• Assisted in developing the CI/CD pipeline for the Cloud products and introduced the use of Spinnaker.
• Built the early prototypes that automate software deployment to Google Cloud for new customers, using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform.
• Created and implemented technical architectures for data migration from OnPrem (MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle DB) to Google Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL).
• Implemented modifications to back-end code (JAVA, Spring Boot) and front-end code (Angular)
• Obtained Google Cloud’s Associate Cloud Engineer certification.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, troubleshooted, and executed PLC code utilizing Siemens STEP 7, Ladder Logic, Grafcets, Function Blocks, and Structured Text Language.
• Designed and implemented software solutions for nuclear fuel manufacturing material handling, part tracking, and data storage and retrieval.
• Conducted PLC software tests on Siemens PLC (SIMATIC S7-400) test platform utilizing Siemens STEP 7 and WinCC Open Architecture (SCADA), and delivered two complete software programs for commissioning.
• Produced and maintained detailed and accurate documentation supporting each control system project.
• Reviewed Engineering change requests and evaluated their impact to existing PLC programs.
• Supported Startup Engineers in carrying out Siemens PLC and Triconex Safety Systems' integration tests.
• Obtained STÄUBLI Robotics programmer certification (VAL3 Level1 CS8C).
positions.insights: Software Development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed PLC programs for control system projects using Siemens STEP 7.
• Led and conducted PLC software tests on Siemens PLC (SIMATIC S7-400) test platform utilizing Siemens STEP 7 and Siemens FactoryLink (SCADA), and delivered two complete software programs for commissioning.
• Analyzed and interpreted mechanical drawings, machine operation documentation, and company standard programming requirements to construct and maintain comprehensive software design documents and test specifications.
• Collaborated with Design Engineers, Responsible Engineers, and Startup Engineers to assist in various modifications, optimizations, and software validation.

projects.title: somethingSpecial, e-commerce app
projects.description:
Online Retailer Web App providing a wide range of unique gifts ideas for the users to choose and order from.

Achievements:
• Built an e-commerce application implementing product categories, searches, reviews, and wish list functionalities by leveraging RESTful APIs and standardized CRUD patterns.
• Devised the product search bar by combining search queries capabilities with an autocomplete feature—based on a pre-fetched list of product titles—resulting in richer UI/UX.
• Reached a responsive design by combining CSS media queries, Flexbox layout, and the usage of multiple margin, padding, and font sizes.

Ruby-on-Rails, React.js, Redux.js, PostgreSQL

projects.title: Game of Thrones | D3, Interactive Data Presentations using D3.js
projects.description:
This application explores the interactions between the various characters of HBO series Game of Thrones through several D3.js visualization techniques.

Achievements:
• Created an interactive network visualization by integrating D3.js’ Force Layout library and incorporating Zoom and Pan features for an enhanced usability and more intuitive UX.
• Built a co-occurence 2-D matrix and barchart by implementing D3.js’ Axis component for all graph axis and utilized the axis’ Linear and Ordinal Scaling, CSS media queries, and Flexbox layout to achieve a responsive design.

D3.js, React.js, Redux.js, Express.js, Node.js
